：哥哥，你也是灾民吗？（：哥哥，你也是灾民吗？（第22页）“不会。”江澜摇摇头，“因为有我在，所以她不会死。”“好了，我带你们走。”说着，江澜便伸出手，去解她们身上的绳子。许梨往后一躲。江澜瞥了她一眼。“你自己能解开？”许梨低下头，看了看手上的绳结。绳子绑得很紧，她纤细的手腕，已经被勒的有些发青，根本使不上什么力气。看见她的样子，江澜道：“那就别逞强。”他弯腰解开姐妹二人的绳子。许满立即抱住许梨，低着头，眼泪夺眶而出。江澜站起身。“走吧。”“去哪儿？”“找个能活命的地方。”许梨抬头看着江澜。“你也要卖我们？”江澜气不打一处来。“老子要卖你，还给你解个屁的绳子，你那点小聪明能不能不用到这些没用的上来？”许梨：“哦。”江澜也懒得废话，直接一手一个，抄起两个小丫头。这突如其来的动作，给两个小丫头吓了一跳。不过等走了一段，她俩也就逐渐适应了。走在街上，江澜看向许梨问道：“账册在哪儿？”许梨当即面色一变，戒备地就要挣开江澜的怀抱。江澜：“……”他把手臂紧了紧，重新将许梨圈住。“老实点。”许梨这小丫头，年纪不大，但心思是真的深沉。只不过，这份深沉，有点儿用错了地方。但现在也不是追问的时候。先走吧。江澜没打算回镇魔司。这两个小姑娘，肯定是不可能带进天牢的。沈清寒的小宅也不行。毕竟，镇魔司的人，已经盯上了那地方。至于贫民窟，那就更不用说了。想来想去，能暂时藏人的地方，竟然只有他那个破院。就离谱。他自己都快成灾民了，这下好，还得收留两个真灾民。看着默不作声的江澜，许梨又问道：“你要带我们去哪儿？”“反正不是给你卖了就是了，小丫头家家，哪儿那么多话。”接着，江澜闭口不语，一路带着两个孩子，回到自己的小院中。小院破旧，杂草丛生。到了院子，江澜把两个小姑娘放下，推开房门。许梨站在门口，看了看院子，又看了看里面的屋子，沉默一会儿，才养起脑袋道：“你也是灾民吗？”江澜：“……”他深吸一口气。“会说话你就少说点，极简风，极简风懂吗？”许梨抿了抿嘴，似乎在忍着笑。而许满，则是躲在许梨身后，偷偷看了江澜一眼。江澜带着两个小姑娘进屋，手伸进怀中，拿出刚才带的一小包糖糕，放在桌上。“吃吧。”许梨一动不动，盯着江澜。许满一张小脸上满是渴望，但也被许梨给按住。江澜：“……”“没下毒。”许梨：“我不信。”江澜：“？”他自己拿起一块咬了一口，咀嚼几下，吞入腹中。“看见没？真没毒。”许梨犹豫了片刻，这才终于拿起一块糖糕，小心翼翼递给旁边的许满。“谢谢你……”

Chapter 25: Brother, are you also a disaster victim (Page 1)
:Brother, are you also a disaster victim? (: Brother, are you also a disaster victim? (Page 22) "No." Jiang Lan shook his head, "Because I am here, she will not die." "Okay, I will take you away." With that, Jiang Lan reached out to untie the ropes on their bodies. Xu Li ducked back. Jiang Lan glanced at her. "Can you untie it yourself?" Xu Li lowered her head and looked at the knot in her hand. The rope was tied tightly, her slender hands His wrists were already bruised and he couldn't use any strength at all. Seeing her appearance, Jiang Lan said, "Don't be brave." He bent down and untied the two sisters. Xu Man immediately hugged Xu Li and lowered his head with tears in his eyes. "Let's go." "Where?" "Find a place to survive." Xu Li looked up at Jiang Lan. "You want to sell us too?" Come on. "I'm going to sell you, and I'll give you a piece of shit. Can you use your little cleverness on these useless things?" Xu Li: "Oh." Jiang Lan didn't bother to talk, and picked up the two little girls one by one. This sudden movement shocked the two little girls. After walking for a while, they gradually got used to it. Jiang Lan looked at Xu Li and asked, "Where is the account book?" Where?" Xu Li's face immediately changed, and she was about to break away from Jiang Lan's arms. Jiang Lan: "..." He tightened his arms and hugged Xu Li again. "Be honest." Xu Li is a young girl, but her thoughts are really deep. However, this depth is a bit misplaced. But now is not the time to ask. Let's go first. Jiang Lan has no intention of returning to Zhenmo Division. These two girls, It's definitely impossible to bring him into the prison. After all, the people from the Zhenmo Division have already targeted that place. Let alone the slums. After thinking about it, it's ridiculous that the only place he can hide people is. He is almost a disaster victim. Now, he has to take in two real victims. Where are we going?" "Anyway, we're just selling it to you, little girl, there's so much talk." Then, Jiang Lan kept silent and took the two children back to his small courtyard. The courtyard was dilapidated and overgrown. When he arrived at the courtyard, Jiang Lan put the two little girls down and opened the door. Xu Li stood at the door, looked at the yard, and then at the house inside, and stayed silent for a while before raising his head. "Are you also a victim?" Jiang Lan said, "..." He took a deep breath. "If you can speak, speak less. Minimalist style, understand?" Xu Li pursed her lips and seemed to be holding back a smile. Xu Man, on the other hand, hid behind Xu Li and glanced at Jiang Lan secretly. Jiang Lan entered the room with his hand, took out the small bag of candy cakes he had just brought, and put it on the table. He didn't move and stared at Jiang Lan. Xu Man's face was full of desire, but Xu Li held it down. Jiang Lan: "..." "It's not poisoned." Xu Li: "I don't believe it." Jiang Lan: "?" He took a bite, chewed it a few times, and swallowed it. "See? It's really not poisonous." Xu Li hesitated for a moment, then finally picked up a piece of candy cake and handed it to Xu Man next to him carefully.
